reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Small claims court separate docket and hearing schedules
headings.reviewNote: Requires judges hearing small claims cases to maintain a separate docket with reasonable hearing times including evenings and Saturdays.

headings.title: Designation of court as small claims court
headings.reviewNote: Designates the circuit court as small claims court when hearing small claims matters.

headings.title: Assignment of small claims cases among associate circuit judges
headings.reviewNote: Governs case filing and assignment between associate circuit judges in single-judge and multi-judge counties.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 3 subsections governing separate small claims dockets, court designation, and case assignment among associate circuit judges.

headings.title: Five thousand dollar jurisdictional limit and excess claim waiver
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes actions exceeding five thousand dollars subject to waiver of any recovery in excess of the statutory limit.

headings.title: Amendment of claims and counterclaims upon transfer to circuit court
headings.reviewNote: Permits amending claims or counterclaims up to the jurisdictional limit of the receiving division upon transfer.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on the $5,000 small claims ceiling, excess claim waiver, and claim/counterclaim amendments after section 482.325 transfer.

headings.title: Permissive counterclaims not arising from same transaction
headings.reviewNote: Permits filing permissive counterclaims within ten days of service and before hearing under standard pleading rules.

headings.title: Compulsory counterclaims arising from same transaction or occurrence
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes raising counterclaims arising from the same transaction or occurrence up to and including the time of hearing.

headings.title: Judicial inquiry and judgment on unpleaded transaction counterclaims
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the judge to question parties and render judgment on transaction-related counterclaims as if formally raised.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 3 subsections covering non-transaction counterclaims, same-transaction counterclaims up to hearing, and judicial inquiry on unpleaded counterclaims.

headings.title: Bar on claims by assignees and twelve-claim annual filing limit
headings.reviewNote: Bars assignees from small claims court and limits parties to twelve claims per calendar year subject to dismissal without prejudice.

headings.title: Mandatory non-assignee and annual filing limit certification
headings.reviewNote: Requires plaintiffs to sign statements certifying non-assignee status and compliance with twelve-claim annual limit.

headings.title: Counterclaims exempted from assignee and annual filing limits
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that prohibitions against assignees and filing limits do not bar transaction-related counterclaims.

headings.title: Venue requirements based on defendant residence or transaction location
headings.reviewNote: Restricts venue to counties where defendants reside, where plaintiffs reside and defendants are found, or where facts occurred.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 4 subsections on assignee bans, the 12-claim annual limit, plaintiff certifications, counterclaim exceptions, and county venue rules.

headings.title: Clerk assistance to litigants and posted notice requirements
headings.reviewNote: Requires clerks to explain procedures and assist litigants with forms without cost, posting notice of assistance.

headings.title: Posting of filing office and courtroom locations in court building
headings.reviewNote: Mandates conspicuous posting of filing office and courtroom locations within the court building.

headings.title: Plaintiff scheduling preference designation at time of filing
headings.reviewNote: Requires plaintiffs to state preference for daytime, evening, or Saturday hearings upon filing.

headings.title: Clerk assistance excluded from practice of law and provided without cost
headings.reviewNote: Provides that clerk procedural assistance does not constitute the practice of law and must be provided free of charge.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 4 subsections on clerk assistance to litigants, posted location notices, hearing-time preferences, and non-practice-of-law/no-cost status.

headings.title: Statutory petition form and jury trial waiver warning
headings.reviewNote: Establishes standard small claims petition form and mandates explicit jury trial waiver notice.

headings.title: Statutory summons form and informal procedure disclosure
headings.reviewNote: Sets standard summons form notifying defendants of default judgment risks and informal evidentiary rules.

headings.title: Service of petition, summons, and explanatory instructions to defendant
headings.reviewNote: Requires attaching petition copy and standard instruction form to summons outlining settlement, appearance, and counterclaims.

headings.title: Free availability of small claims forms and procedures from clerk
headings.reviewNote: Requires small claims court clerk to provide copies of all applicable forms and procedures to any person without charge.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 4 subsections and embedded petition, summons, and defendant instruction forms (noting legacy "$1,000" and "three other claims" text in statutory forms); replaced mismatched subsection 4 heading.

headings.title: Court costs and security deposit required upon filing
headings.reviewNote: Requires plaintiffs in small claims actions to pay court costs and security deposits under sections 488.010 to 488.020 (*original rolls cite section 514.015).

headings.title: Advance payment of service and process fees
headings.reviewNote: Mandates advance payment of service of process fees upon filing small claims actions.

headings.title: Discretionary assessment and award of fees and court costs
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court discretion in awarding fees and assessing court costs between parties.

headings.title: Disbursement of collected court costs under statutory provisions
headings.reviewNote: Requires disbursement of small claims court costs in accordance with sections 488.010 to 488.020 (*original rolls cite section 514.015).

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 4 subsections and original-rolls footnote (*section 514.015 changed to 488.010–488.020) governing small claims costs, service fees, and disbursements.

headings.title: Defendant appearance, good cause continuances, and deemed denial
headings.reviewNote: Requires appearance on summons date, restricts continuances to good cause, and treats non-answer as general denial.

headings.title: Default judgment on plaintiff prima facie case and dismissal rules
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes default judgment on plaintiff prima facie proof upon defendant default, and dismissal if plaintiff fails to appear.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on defendant appearance, good-cause continuances, deemed denial, prima facie default judgments, and plaintiff-nonappearance dismissals.

headings.title: Prohibition on small claims judgments operating as real estate liens
headings.reviewNote: Bars small claims judgments from operating as liens on real estate.

headings.title: Trial de novo application, ten-day deadline, bond, and circuit practice
headings.reviewNote: Establishes right to trial de novo within ten days, requiring recognizance bond to stay execution and applying circuit rules.

headings.title: Clerk assistance to judgment creditors for judgment satisfaction
headings.reviewNote: Directs clerks to assist judgment creditors in preparing forms to obtain satisfaction of final judgments.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 3 subsections and Palmore v. City of Pacific (393 S.W.3d 657) annotation on real estate lien bar, trial de novo procedure, and judgment satisfaction assistance.
